saw_lines: Leather buyers compare material and stitching before they pay, then keep one bag for years, not every season.
So the sale is won in the first line of the ad, before a buyer opens a second tab to compare.
5 of your 10 copy ads open on the same pack your essentials line, so test three new openers from your briefcase, belt and card holder against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Five of your 10 copy ads open on the same “pack your essentials” line, so repeat viewers stop reading. Test three new openers from your range: the commute briefcase, the reversible belt and the slim card holder, each run against it.
None of your 26 ads is a video, so buyers never see a bag opened, carried or worn. Shoot three short videos of the briefcase, belt and dopp kit in use, and run each as the lead ad for its product.
One exact copy runs in 5 of your 10 copy ads, so the same words reach the same people repeatedly. Keep that copy, but change the opening line and creative in each ad, so every version reads as new.
No proof number in your ads

None of your 26 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

ads_1: Briefcase, belt and card holder openers tested against the pack your essentials hook
